description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class for managing report mailing jobs in the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for creating, updating, deleting, retrieving individual, and listing report mailing jobs, as well as fetching templates. The class uses JAX-RS annotations for REST endpoints, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and interacts with various services for security, serialization, and business logic.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing report mailing jobs, including CRUD operations and listing.

methods.name: createReportMailingJob
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new report mailing job.

methods.name: updateReportMailingJob
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing report mailing job identified by entityId.

methods.name: deleteReportMailingJob
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a report mailing job identified by entityId.

methods.name: retrieveReportMailingJob
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve details of a specific report mailing job by entityId.

methods.name: retrieveReportMailingJobTemplate
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a template for report mailing job details.

methods.name: retrieveAllReportMailingJobs
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all report mailing jobs with optional pagination and sorting.
